title: Tidal Minute Archive
constraints: no external fonts — system fonts only

workerResult.summary: Tidal Minute Archive — organic-brutalist tide-clock instrument. 12-step SVG looping sequencer (WebAudio bell/shell/kelp/fog chimes, tide-modulated filter/velocity, 40-160bpm, evolve mutations), one-tap sampling via TAP button/Space quantized to playhead, history ribbon laying a colored stratum per loop (click-to-reload, localStorage persist), and exportable loop cards (PNG canvas render, copy-text, JSON). System fonts only, works from file://, responsive to 375px.
